prompt:
EXACT DURATION: 30 SECONDS
16:9 | ULTRA-PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION

Create the first 30 seconds of one continuous cinematic film about two young Korean friends experiencing traditional Korean life. It must look like authentic professional live-action filmed in Korea, never AI-generated.

CHARACTER LOCK — ABSOLUTE

Use the uploaded Young Korean Woman and Young Korean Man Character References exactly.

Woman: 23. Man: 24.

Preserve exact faces, eyes, noses, lips, skin tones, hairstyles, hair lengths, body proportions, height relationship, ages and identities. No redesign, beautification, aging, body changes, face changes or identity drift. Same people throughout Parts 1 and 2.

STORY

Two young Korean friends begin their morning in an authentic hanok and naturally experience traditional Korean life together. Intimate, observational and respectful. Friendship only, no romance.

SCENE 1 — DAWN | 0:00–0:06

Authentic Korean hanok at dawn. Sunlight through paper doors. Woman wakes, opens a wooden door and enters the courtyard. Man appears from another room. They exchange a subtle smile and walk together.

Real wood, breeze and morning birds.

Korean title: 한국의 하루
English: A Day in Traditional Korea

SCENE 2 — BREAKFAST | 0:06–0:12

Inside the hanok, they sit at a low traditional Korean table with steaming rice, soup, banchan, ceramic bowls and chopsticks.

Man serves food. Woman smiles. They eat naturally. No posing or exaggerated reactions.

Korean subtitle: 하루는 함께하는 아침에서 시작됩니다.
English: A day begins with a morning shared together.

SCENE 3 — HANBOK | 0:12–0:18

They prepare to leave.

Woman: exact reference hanbok, ivory jeogori + muted dusty-rose chima.
Man: exact reference hanbok, cream jeogori + deep muted navy baji.

Show realistic fabric as she ties her ribbon and he adjusts his sleeve. Natural interaction.

SCENE 4 — HANOK ALLEY | 0:18–0:24

They walk through a peaceful historic Korean neighborhood with authentic hanok rooftops, wooden doors, stone walls and local residents.

Camera follows from behind, then subtle side tracking. Quiet conversation, natural sunlight and movement.

SCENE 5 — TRADITIONAL MARKET | 0:24–0:30

They enter a lively Korean market with authentic vendors, Korean signs, ingredients, snacks, steam and food stalls.

Woman stops at a stall. Vendor gives her a traditional Korean snack. She examines it naturally while man smiles. Slow push toward her expression.

CRITICAL END FRAME

At exactly 30 seconds, woman stands beside the stall holding the snack in her RIGHT HAND. Man stands immediately on her LEFT. Both wear the exact hanbok and look toward the vendor.

This exact frame MUST become Part 2's opening state.

CINEMATOGRAPHY

35mm / 50mm / occasional 85mm. Natural handheld, subtle tracking, realistic focus pulls, depth of field and motion blur.

No floating camera, impossible movement, excessive slow motion, speed ramps or artificial lens effects.

LIGHTING

Natural morning sunlight, realistic shadows, natural skin tones and restrained grading.

AUDIO

Authentic Korean ambience: birds, doors, footsteps, dishes, chopsticks, conversation, vendors, market sounds and sizzling food. Very subtle traditional Korean music. Dialogue and environment dominate.

ABSOLUTE REALISM

Real humans, realistic Korean faces, natural skin, eyes, teeth and hair. Correct hands and fingers. Realistic clothing, food, steam, shadows and architecture.

NO CGI, animation, anime, plastic skin, AI faces, face morphing, identity changes, duplicated people, wardrobe changes, malformed hands or distorted environments.

Maintain exact characters, wardrobe, lighting, environment and quality across every shot. Final result must look like high-end Korean live-action footage.

translations.zh:
精准时长：30秒
16:9 | 超写实实拍风格

制作一部长达30秒的连续电影感短片的第一部分，讲述两位年轻韩国好友体验传统韩国生活的故事。必须呈现出在韩国拍摄的专业实拍质感，绝无AI生成痕迹。

角色锁定 — 绝对一致
严格使用已上传的年轻韩国女性和年轻韩国男性的角色参考。
女性：23岁。男性：24岁。
精准保留面容、五官、肤色、发型、发长、身体比例及身高差。禁止改动外形或身份漂移。

故事情节
两位年轻韩国朋友在传统韩屋开启清晨，亲切自然地体验传统韩国生活。

场景 1 — 黎明 | 0:00–0:06
清晨的韩屋，晨光穿透纸门。女子醒来推门入庭院，男子从另一房间走出，两人相视微笑并同行。木纹质感、清风与晨鸟鸣叫。
韩文标题：한국의 하루
英文：A Day in Traditional Korea

场景 2 — 早餐 | 0:06–0:12
韩屋内，两人围坐在韩式矮桌前享用热气腾腾的米饭、汤与小菜。男子盛饭，女子微笑，自然进餐。
韩文字幕：하루는 함께하는 아침에서 시작됩니다.
英文：A day begins with a morning shared together.

场景 3 — 韩服 | 0:12–0:18
准备出门。女子系带，男子整理衣袖，展示出真实的布料质感与自然互动。

场景 4 — 韩屋小巷 | 0:18–0:24
两人漫步在历史感十足的韩屋石墙街道上，镜头尾随侧拍，微风拂动。

场景 5 — 传统集市 | 0:24–0:30
步入热闹的韩国传统集市，小摊贩递给女子传统点心，男子在一旁微笑注视。

关键结尾帧
恰好在第30秒，女子右手拿着小吃站在摊位旁，男子立于左侧，均身着指定韩服面向摊主。

摄影与灯光
35mm/50mm/85mm，自然手持与跟拍，柔和晨光，避免悬浮镜头与夸张特效。

音频与写实度
鸟鸣、推门声、餐具碰撞与集市喧哗，极淡传统背景音乐。真实人物皮肤、肢体与光影细节。
